crossRefs.note: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

translations.web: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
translations.bsb: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
